read_clipboard_read_csv: read text from the system clipboard and parse it as a CSV into a polars DataFrame
read_clipboard_read_excel: read tabular data copied from Excel into the clipboard and convert it to a polars DataFrame
read_clipboard_custom_separator: read clipboard content using a custom separator character instead of the default tab
read_clipboard_with_kwargs: read clipboard data as CSV and pass additional read_csv arguments like dtype or columns
read_clipboard_parse_json: read clipboard text and parse it as structured tabular data into a polars DataFrame
